info.name: Buk Attendance — Biometric Integration Clockings API

items.docs:
Creates a new attendance clocking record from data sent by a biometric device middleware.

### Authentication

This endpoint uses provider-based authentication via two custom headers:

| Header             | Description                                      |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `x-provider-name`  | Registered provider name                         |
| `x-provider-token` | Secret token assigned to the provider            |
